page.layout: Two printed columns side by side on one page. Left column: Hebrew verb entries with Latin glosses, continuing from the previous page. Right column: continuation of the entries under the section letter ע. Page number at top left. Section letters ם and ע printed at the head, centre-left and centre-right.

main_text.l: [i]xit eum, [Hebrew: וַיִּסְרֵהוּ] eam, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. [Hebrew: סוּר].
[Hebrew: יִסְרַנִי] erudivit me, [Hebrew: יִסְרֵהוּ] e-rudivisti eum, [Hebrew: יִסְרַתַּנִּי] me, [Hebrew: יִסְרְתֵּךְ] erudivite, præt. Piel, 3. & 2. f. m. aff. & 1. f. aff. Rad. [Hebrew: יָסַר].
[Hebrew: וַיָּסֶת] & incitavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. [Hebrew: סוּת] [?].
[Hebrew: יִסְבַּל] onustam reddet se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. [Hebrew: סְבַל].
[Hebrew: יִסְתְּמוּ] obturabunt, [Hebrew: וַיִּסְתְּמוּ] & obturaverunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. [Hebrew: סְתַם].
[Hebrew: וַיִּסְתְּמוּם] & obturaverunt eos, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. præf. aff. Rad. [Hebrew: סָתַם].
[Hebrew: יִסְתֹּר] abscondet, [Hebrew: יִסָּתֵר] abscondetur, [Hebrew: יִסָּתְרוּ] abscondentur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. [Hebrew: סָתַר].
[Hebrew: יִסְתְּרֵנִי] occultabit, [Hebrew: יִסְתְּרֵנִי] me, [Hebrew: יִסְתְּרֵם] eos, [Hebrew: יִסְתְּרוּ] occultabunt, fut. Hiph.
3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. Rad. [Hebrew: סָתַר].
[Hebrew: יַעֲבֹד] servietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. [Hebrew: עָבַד].
[Hebrew: וַיַּעְבֵּד] & servire fecit, [Hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ] & servire fecerunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. præf. R. [Hebrew: עָבַד].
[Hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדֵם] & servivit eis, [Hebrew: יַעַבְדוּךָ] servient tibi, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. [Hebrew: עָבַד].
[Hebrew: יַעְפְּטוּן] pervertent, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. [Hebrew: עָבַט] pignoratus est.

[Hebrew: יַעֲבִיר] transmittet, [Hebrew: יַעַבְרֵם] eos, [Hebrew: יַעַבְרֵהוּ] eum, [Hebrew: יַעַבְרֵנִי] me, [Hebrew: יַעֲבִירוּ] transmittent, [Hebrew: יַעֲבִירוּם] eos, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. sing. & pl. m. aff. Rad. [Hebrew: עָבַר].

[Hebrew: יַעֲבֹר] transibit, [Hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר] et transivit, [Hebrew: יַעַבְרֵנָּהוּ] transibit eum, [Hebrew: יַעַבְרוּם] transibunt eos, [Hebrew: יַעַבְרֵנָּהוּ] eum, pro [Hebrew: יַעַבְרֵהוּ], & [Hebrew: יַעַבְרוּהוּ].

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied as closely as the scan allows, but many vowel points and consonants are blurred; each Hebrew word is uncertain and should be checked against the original. The root marked [?] (סוּת) and the Hebrew of the first line are doubtful. Left column's first line begins mid-entry and is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The section letters ם and ע are printed at the head and were taken as running head. The final Hebrew form at the foot of the right column is partly cut off and may be incomplete.
